calibration.status: provisional; derive from multiple measured door/corridor dimensions before deployment

map.classification: binary approximation from image threshold; not a surveyed CAD/Nav2 production map

processing: saturated green/red annotations excluded from the dark-line mask
dark strokes conservatively dilated for initial obstacle visibility
convex hull of detected strokes used as an exterior safety envelope
fine text, furniture and door symbols may still be present as obstacles
required_review: confirm building identity and floor plan orientation
measure at least 5 door widths and 2 corridor widths
manually trace principal walls and door openings
validate map against a real scan or authorized CAD drawing before navigation
